summary: BRBI BR Partners S.A., a Brazilian finance-services foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its condensed parent-company and consolidated interim financial information for the three- and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026, signed by IR Officer Vinicius Carmona Cardoso on November 5, 2026. The exhibit is a quarterly management report covering macroeconomic context—Middle East conflict, energy shock, global rate tightening, and Brazil's Selic cuts to 13.75%—plus financial statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed, so this is a routine earnings filing rather than a special situation; no deal terms apply.
